---
title: "Request a Quote"
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<style>
.brs-quote-wrap{max-width:1050px;margin:20px auto 70px;padding:0 22px}
.brs-quote-kicker{font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#087aa3;margin-bottom:.45rem}
.brs-quote-wrap h1{font-size:2.55rem;color:#123f5d;margin-bottom:.6rem}
.brs-quote-lead{max-width:820px;color:#5f7480;line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.brs-quote-note{background:#eef7fb;border-left:4px solid #087aa3;padding:13px 15px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;color:#385665;margin-bottom:26px}
.brs-form-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce6eb;border-radius:15px;padding:22px;margin:0 0 18px;box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(20,61,88,.055)}
.brs-form-card h2{font-size:1.16rem;color:#123f5d;margin:0 0 17px}
.brs-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px}
.brs-quote-wrap label,.brs-quote-wrap legend{font-size:.91rem;font-weight:700;color:#2d4e61}
.brs-quote-wrap input[type=text],
.brs-quote-wrap input[type=email],
.brs-quote-wrap input[type=tel],
.brs-quote-wrap input[type=number],
.brs-quote-wrap input[type=date],
.brs-quote-wrap select,
.brs-quote-wrap textarea{
 width:100%;margin-top:6px;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid #bacbd5;border-radius:8px;
 background:white;color:#213e4e;font:inherit
}
.brs-quote-wrap textarea{resize:vertical}
.brs-checks{border:0;padding:10px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px 16px}
.brs-checks label{font-weight:500}
.brs-submit{background:#08739b;color:#fff;border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 20px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.brs-submit:hover{background:#075f80}
.brs-small{font-size:.82rem;color:#718591;line-height:1.55}
.brs-hidden{display:none}
.brs-consent{display:block;margin:19px 0}
@media(max-width:720px){.brs-grid,.brs-checks{grid-template-columns:1fr}.brs-quote-wrap h1{font-size:2rem}}
</style>

<section class="brs-quote-wrap">
  <div class="brs-quote-kicker">BASE RUNNING SCIENCE™</div>
  <h1>Request a Quote</h1>
  <p class="brs-quote-lead">
    Complete the structured information below so Base Running Science can determine scope,
    athlete/staff requirements, location, technology needs, deliverables, and pricing.
  </p>

  <div class="brs-quote-note">
    This form is specifically for quote requests. General inquiries use the separate Contact page.
  </div>

  <form name="brs-quote-request"
        method="POST"
        action="/quote-thank-you.html"
        data-netlify="true"
        netlify-honeypot="bot-field">

    <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="brs-quote-request">

    <p class="brs-hidden">
      <label>Do not fill this out: <input name="bot-field"></label>
    </p>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>1. Contact & organization</h2>
      <div class="brs-grid">
        <label>
          Contact name *
          <input type="text" name="contact_name" required>
        </label>

        <label>
          Organization / team *
          <input type="text" name="organization" required>
        </label>

        <label>
          Email *
          <input type="email" name="email" required>
        </label>

        <label>
          Phone
          <input type="tel" name="phone">
        </label>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>2. Service requested</h2>

      <label>
        Primary service *
        <select name="primary_service" required>
          <option value="">Choose one</option>
          <option>Training & Assessment</option>
          <option>Consultancy / Advisory</option>
          <option>Software / Decision Support</option>
          <option>Continuing Education</option>
          <option>Apparel / Collaboration</option>
          <option>Multi-service project</option>
        </select>
      </label>

      <fieldset class="brs-checks">
        <legend>Components needed</legend>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Linear sprint assessment"> Linear sprint assessment</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Curvilinear/base-running assessment"> Curvilinear / base-running assessment</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="GPS diagnostics"> GPS diagnostics</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="IMU foot-pod diagnostics"> IMU foot-pod diagnostics</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Individualized training prescription"> Individualized training prescription</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Staff education/workshop"> Staff education / workshop</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Reporting/decision support"> Reporting / decision support</label>
        <label><input type="checkbox" name="components[]" value="Apparel/event collaboration"> Apparel / event collaboration</label>
      </fieldset>
    </section>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>3. Project scope</h2>
      <div class="brs-grid">
        <label>
          Number of athletes *
          <input type="number" name="athlete_count" min="1" required>
        </label>

        <label>
          Number of coaches / staff
          <input type="number" name="staff_count" min="0">
        </label>

        <label>
          City / location *
          <input type="text" name="location" required>
        </label>

        <label>
          Preferred date
          <input type="date" name="preferred_date">
        </label>

        <label>
          Expected duration
          <select name="duration">
            <option value="">Choose one</option>
            <option>Half day</option>
            <option>1 day</option>
            <option>2 days</option>
            <option>3+ days</option>
            <option>Recurring / ongoing</option>
            <option>Not sure yet</option>
          </select>
        </label>

        <label>
          Date flexibility
          <select name="date_flexibility">
            <option value="">Choose one</option>
            <option>Fixed date</option>
            <option>Some flexibility</option>
            <option>Very flexible</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>4. Apparel / collaboration details (if applicable)</h2>
      <div class="brs-grid">
        <label>
          Estimated quantity
          <input type="number" name="apparel_quantity" min="1">
        </label>

        <label>
          Apparel type
          <select name="apparel_type">
            <option value="">Choose one</option>
            <option>Training shorts</option>
            <option>Short sleeve</option>
            <option>Long sleeve</option>
            <option>Sleeveless hoodie</option>
            <option>Multiple items</option>
            <option>Other</option>
          </select>
        </label>
      </div>

      <label>
        Sizes, artwork, event, or collaboration details
        <textarea name="apparel_details" rows="4"
          placeholder="Example: 112 training shorts, athlete + coach sizing, collaboration marks, event date, etc."></textarea>
      </label>
    </section>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>5. Project objective</h2>

      <label>
        What are you trying to accomplish? *
        <textarea name="project_goal" rows="5" required
          placeholder="Describe the performance, assessment, education, advisory, software, or event objective."></textarea>
      </label>

      <label>
        Existing technology / resources
        <textarea name="existing_resources" rows="4"
          placeholder="GPS, timing gates, IMU foot pods, field access, staff availability, etc."></textarea>
      </label>

      <label>
        Additional requirements
        <textarea name="additional_requirements" rows="4"></textarea>
      </label>
    </section>

    <section class="brs-form-card">
      <h2>6. Budget context (optional)</h2>
      <label>
        Approximate project budget
        <select name="budget_range">
          <option value="">Not established / prefer not to say</option>
          <option>Under $1,000</option>
          <option>$1,000–$2,499</option>
          <option>$2,500–$4,999</option>
          <option>$5,000–$9,999</option>
          <option>$10,000+</option>
        </select>
      </label>
    </section>

    <label class="brs-consent">
      <input type="checkbox" name="accuracy_confirmation" required>
      I confirm that this information is accurate enough for Base Running Science to prepare an initial quote.
    </label>

    <button class="brs-submit" type="submit">Submit Quote Request</button>

    <p class="brs-small">
      Submission does not create a contract or booking. Final scope, availability, travel,
      deliverables, payment terms, and pricing are confirmed separately.
    </p>
  </form>
</section>
```
